title: VibeOffice
summary: Your pocket office suite: open, edit and present .docx, .xlsx and .pptx files.
description:
Opens, edits and saves real .docx, .xlsx and .pptx files on the CardputerZero: read a document on the go, check a spreadsheet, or connect an HDMI screen and present your slides.

It is made for the keyboard and the 320×170 screen, and keeps your files in ~/VibeOffice/Documents; copy them in over Wi-Fi with any SFTP app.
